summary: Saskatchewan light steel fire tower, 24.4 m (80 ft) tall, given a new cupola in 1957 and a complete overhaul in 1963, per the 1963-64 annual report; no source describes the site today.

events.note: A new cupola was put on the tower.
The tower was completely overhauled, per the 1963-64 Department of Natural Resources annual report as quoted on Canada Lookouts.

evidence.supports: The tower is 80 ft tall and of light steel.
Listed position of the Beaver House site.

evidence.quote: The tower at Beaver House was completely overhauled.

notes_for_editor: Two sources only. The story is about 125 words, which is at the floor of the length range because the evidence has no build date, no staffing names and no fires. Both the height (24.4 m) and the 1957 and 1963 events in the brief are supported. The brief's agency is supported by the 1963-64 annual report quote. Two searches found no other source. The site today is not described by any source read.
